scope: Integrate and offline-qualify an NST-specific enclosing job lifecycle in these exact direct-job, Python/proxy and script boundaries and their listed tests: durable owner-token begin, each provider attempt bound to that token, finish only after all provider fan-out and output work has settled, hold on unknown/expired execution. Preserve business-output versus audit-durability distinctions, request/response compatibility, bounded retries, whole-plan eligibility and existing aggregate rate limits. Keep activation disabled until every participating caller and companion is integrated and qualified.
excluded: Every unlisted source/test, global audit wrapper, rate-policy module/tests, runner UI, WGO/Yahoo/FORGE, accepted immutable packet/SQL, schedules, production settings and all runtime/release operations. Prior exact goalie/runner/report/shared-adapter transfers remain effective.
outsideCurrentTransferQualification: These five direct-client consumers were identified by the bounded prior import inventory and had no matching exact recorded claim then. They are not owned or transferred by this receipt. This is not a fresh all-repository coverage or current-owner assessment. Coordinate their actual current owners before any edits; no missing claim grants custody. No claim that all NST participants are now integrated.
jobLifecycleConstraints: Durable owner/token begin and shared admission bound to that identity must cover the whole enclosing job, not one fetch. Every attempt/retry/duplicate consumes the same aggregate rate budget.

Finish only after provider fan-out, parsing, persistence and other owned output/checkpoint work is settled. Python proxy HTTP completion alone does not prove the web parent job and its persistence ended; preserve parent-child occupancy or equivalent enclosing ownership.

Missing/expired owner, uncertain start/finish acknowledgement, process death or missing audit cannot grant goalie clearance or imply completion. Unknown/expired execution remains held/review-required; do not automatically replay uncertain durable output.
No global audit changes are authorized. Preserve business-operation outcomes separately from audit durability and unsafe-retry holds.
Activation stays disabled until all participating callers and Python/proxy companions are integrated, reviewed and qualified. A complete hash handoff is not runtime health or lifecycle qualification.
rateBudget: Preserve aggregate 39-per-rolling-minute, 80-per-5-minutes, 100-per-15-minutes, 180-per-hour attempt limits across callers/processes/hosts. All retries/duplicate URLs count. Retain accepted complete-plan semi-burst behavior and conservative fallback; per-step size must not confer whole-job burst eligibility.
